name: Cossack Dueling OS Package
effect: When you Boost in a straight line, you may elect any Main Melee weapon to use to attack an enemy as a special reaction. Damage dealt, including bonus damage, is halved. The mount used is treated as having Skirmished this turn.
description: A simple OS tuning package that enables most mechs to be more effective in executing hit-and-run attacks.

actions.name: Sideswipe
actions.detail: You may roll to attack with the weapon. Damage dealt, including bonus damage, is halved.
actions.trigger: While Boosting, there is an enemy within Threat of an equipped Main Melee weapon along the path of the Boost.
